dedupe_keys.name: emulate3d digital twin software rockwell automation

description: Emulate3D is Rockwell Automation's digital twin software for machines and automated production and material handling systems. It builds 3D models of equipment that connect to control systems early in a project, so that control and sequencing problems can be found before installation (virtual commissioning), and it runs faster-than-real-time 3D simulation to compare layouts and configurations and to predict performance. Plant staff can also train on new systems in the virtual model. The Emulate3D Factory Test product is integrated with NVIDIA Omniverse APIs and OpenUSD for high-fidelity simulation and collaboration, initially offered in private preview. It is produced by Rockwell Automation as part of its FactoryTalk Design Suite. Coverage is global and generic, for any plant or warehouse modelled by the user. It is sold commercially through Rockwell's ordering and subscription options, with downloads and release notes on its compatibility pages; the page read shows no price. Caveats: the page is marketing material, and models are tied to Rockwell's tool chain. For simulation it is a platform for plant and logistics digital twins that test how production lines behave under changes and disruptions before real equipment is touched. It is related to the Siemens Plant Simulation and FlexSim records in this catalogue, other discrete-event factory simulators.
